However, the claim adds 'plus temporary storage for the COMPACTIFY active ray list'. Source [S1] discusses COMPACTIFY in the context of parallel reduction and list management, but does not link its memory complexity to the stack complexity of the octree traversal in [S2]. The sources are disjoint in their primary focus (one on parallel list compaction, the other on a specific software raytracer's stack implementation).
